adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the replyTo array in organizer-add-guests-email.ts (line 25) includes all attendees' emails, and the schema in addGuests.schema.ts has no limit on the guests array size. This is a valid architectural concern - repeated additions of guests could accumulate to exceed mail provider header limits. However, this is not a bug per se since: 1) it requires many additions over time, 2) most mail providers have generous limits, 3) the code functions correctly for typical use cases. It's a legitimate edge case concern but not a defect in normal operation.
